## Analysis

### From today backwards.
```{r,fig.height=8,fig.width=12}
#' Import data.
data=read.csv("20260816_nbagamelogs.csv",check.names=FALSE)

#' Download team data.
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = 8000000)
assign_nba_teams()

teamnames=df_dict_nba_teams%>%
  select(nameTeam,idTeam)

#' Tiebreaker game IDs, to be removed.
tiebrk=c(24700194,24700193,24900563,
         24900564,25500289,25500290,
         25600289,25600290)

#' Remove games that never occured and tiebreaker games.
data2=data%>%
  filter(is.na(outcomeGame)==FALSE)%>%
  filter(!idGame%in%tiebrk)

#' Calculate from today backwards.
totmid=data2%>%
  #' For each team, place games in order.
  arrange(idTeam,desc(yearSeason),desc(numberGameTeamSeason))%>%
  group_by(idTeam)%>%
  #' At each game, calculate total wins and losses
  mutate(cumWins=cumsum(isWin),
         cumLosses=cumsum(isWin==FALSE),
         cumGames=row_number())%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  #' Calculate winning percentage, then distance from 0.500.
  mutate(statrec=cumWins/sum(cumWins,cumLosses),
         dif500=statrec-0.5,
         absdif500=abs(statrec-0.5))%>%
  ungroup()

#' Create grouping columns for plots.
totmid$y_above <- ifelse(totmid$statrec >= 0.5, totmid$statrec, 0.5)
totmid$y_below <- ifelse(totmid$statrec <= 0.5, totmid$statrec, 0.5)

#' Merge game data with team data.
totmid2=merge(totmid,df_dict_nba_teams,by="idTeam")

#' Filter for current teams only.
curr=totmid2%>%filter(yearPlayedLast==2025)

#' Plot all teams' 0.500.
ggplot(curr,
       aes(x=cumGames,y=statrec))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0.5, ymax = y_above), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y_below, ymax = 0.5), fill = "red", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_star(data=curr%>%
               filter(statrec==0.5),
            fill="gold",
            color="black",
            size=3)+
  geom_text(data=curr%>%
              group_by(idTeam,nameTeam.y)%>%
              summarize(fhun=sum(statrec==0.5),
                        fhun_norm=fhun/max(cumGames),
                        place=median(cumGames)),
            aes(label=paste("n=",fhun,"; ",round(fhun_norm*100,2),"%",sep=""),y=0.8,x=place))+
  facet_wrap(~nameTeam.y,ncol=5,scales="free_x")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("# of Games")+
  ylab("Winning Percentage")
```

### From each team's beginning.
```{r,fig.height=8,fig.width=12}
#' Import data.
data=read.csv("20260816_nbagamelogs.csv",check.names=FALSE)

#' Download team data.
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = 8000000)
assign_nba_teams()

teamnames=df_dict_nba_teams%>%
  select(nameTeam,idTeam)

#' Tiebreaker game IDs, to be removed.
tiebrk=c(24700194,24700193,24900563,
         24900564,25500289,25500290,
         25600289,25600290)

#' Remove games that never occured and tiebreaker games.
data2=data%>%
  filter(is.na(outcomeGame)==FALSE)%>%
  filter(!idGame%in%tiebrk)

#' Calculate from past onwards.
totmid=data2%>%
  #' For each team, place games in order.
  arrange(idTeam,yearSeason,numberGameTeamSeason)%>%
  group_by(idTeam)%>%
  #' At each game, calculate total wins and losses
  mutate(cumWins=cumsum(isWin),
         cumLosses=cumsum(isWin==FALSE),
         cumGames=row_number())%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  #' Calculate winning percentage, then distance from 0.500.
  mutate(statrec=cumWins/sum(cumWins,cumLosses),
         dif500=statrec-0.5,
         absdif500=abs(statrec-0.5))%>%
  ungroup()

#' Create grouping columns for plots.
totmid$y_above <- ifelse(totmid$statrec >= 0.5, totmid$statrec, 0.5)
totmid$y_below <- ifelse(totmid$statrec <= 0.5, totmid$statrec, 0.5)

#' Merge game data with team data.
totmid2=merge(totmid,df_dict_nba_teams,by="idTeam")

#' Filter for current teams only.
curr=totmid2%>%filter(yearPlayedLast==2025)

#' Plot all teams' 0.500.
ggplot(curr,
       aes(x=cumGames,y=statrec))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0.5, ymax = y_above), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y_below, ymax = 0.5), fill = "red", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_star(data=curr%>%
               filter(statrec==0.5),
            fill="gold",
            color="black",
            size=3)+
  geom_text(data=curr%>%
  group_by(idTeam,nameTeam.y)%>%
  summarize(fhun=sum(statrec==0.5),
            fhun_norm=fhun/max(cumGames),
            place=median(cumGames)),
  aes(label=paste("n=",fhun,"; ",round(fhun_norm*100,2),"%",sep=""),y=0.8,x=place))+
  facet_wrap(~nameTeam.y,ncol=5,scales="free_x")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("# of Games")+
  ylab("Winning Percentage")

#' To verify that teams never crossed 0.5 line.
yo=curr%>%group_by(nameTeam.y)%>%
  filter(statrec>=0.5)%>%count()

#' Filter for recent seasons only.
ggplot(curr%>%filter(yearSeason>2024),
       aes(x=cumGames,y=statrec))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0.5, ymax = y_above), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y_below, ymax = 0.5), fill = "red", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_star(data=curr%>%
              filter(yearSeason>2024)%>%
               filter(statrec==0.5),
            fill="gold",
            color="black",
            size=3)+
  geom_text(data=curr%>%filter(yearSeason>2024)%>%
  group_by(idTeam,nameTeam.y)%>%
  summarize(fhun=sum(statrec==0.5),
            fhun_norm=fhun/max(cumGames),
            place=median(cumGames)),
  aes(label=paste("n=",fhun,"; ",round(fhun_norm*100,2),"%",sep=""),y=0.55,x=place))+
  facet_wrap(~nameTeam.y,ncol=5,scales="free_x")+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("# of Games")+
  ylab("Winning Percentage")

#' Count of cumulative mid-ness by season for current teams.
test5=totmid2%>%
  filter(statrec==0.5)%>%
  group_by(nameTeam.y,yearSeason)%>%count()

#' Has a current team ever ended a season at cumulative 0.500?
test6=curr%>%
  group_by(nameTeam.y,yearSeason)%>%
  slice_max(numberGameTeamSeason)%>%
  filter(statrec==0.5)

#' Has any team ever ended a season at cumulative 0.500?
test7=totmid2%>%
  group_by(nameTeam.y,yearSeason)%>%
  slice_max(numberGameTeamSeason)%>%
  filter(statrec==0.5)

#' Pacers
pacers=curr%>%filter(idTeam==1610612754)

#' Plot Pacers 2024 onward.
ggplot(pacers%>%filter(yearSeason>2024),
       aes(x=cumGames,y=statrec))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0.5, ymax = y_above), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = y_below, ymax = 0.5), fill = "red", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_star(data=pacers%>%
              filter(yearSeason>2024)%>%
               filter(statrec==0.5),
            fill="gold",
            color="black",
            size=3)+
  theme_bw()+
  xlab("# of Games")+
  ylab("Winning Percentage")

#' Filter for final cumulative record.
fin=curr%>%filter(yearSeason==2026&numberGameTeamSeason==82)

#' Calculate games needed to get to 0.500.
fin=fin%>%mutate(wl_status=if_else(statrec>0.5,"Need to Lose","Need to Win"),
                 games_needed=if_else(wl_status=="Need to Lose",((2*cumWins)-cumGames),(cumGames-(2*cumWins))))

#' Plot Games needed for 0.500.
pg=ggplot(fin,aes(y=reorder(nameTeam.y,games_needed),x=games_needed,fill=wl_status))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity",color="black")+
  geom_text(aes(label=as.character(games_needed),x=games_needed+30))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("red4","blue"),name="Status")+
  xlab("Games Away from 0.500")+
  ylab("Team")+
  theme_bw()

fivhun=curr%>%filter(statrec==0.500)%>%
  arrange(dateGame)%>%
  mutate(time_diff = difftime(dateGame, lag(dateGame), units = "days"))%>%
  arrange(desc(time_diff))%>%
  select(yearSeason,dateGame,nameTeam.y,time_diff)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(time_diff = difftime(date_column, lag(date_column), units = "days"))
```

### From beginning, within season mid-ness.
```{r,fig.width=14,fig.height=5}
#' Import data.
data=read.csv("20260816_nbagamelogs.csv",check.names=FALSE)

#' Download team data.
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = 8000000)
assign_nba_teams()

teamnames=df_dict_nba_teams%>%
  select(nameTeam,idTeam)

#' Tiebreaker game IDs, to be removed.
tiebrk=c(24700194,24700193,24900563,
         24900564,25500289,25500290,
         25600289,25600290)

#' Remove games that never occured and tiebreaker games.
data2=data%>%
  filter(is.na(outcomeGame)==FALSE)%>%
  filter(!idGame%in%tiebrk)

#' Calculate from past onwards.
totmid=data2%>%
  #' For each team, place games in order.
  arrange(idTeam,yearSeason,numberGameTeamSeason)%>%
  group_by(idTeam,yearSeason)%>%
  #' At each game, calculate total wins and losses
  mutate(cumWins=cumsum(isWin),
         cumLosses=cumsum(isWin==FALSE),
         cumGames=row_number())%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  #' Calculate winning percentage, then distance from 0.500.
  mutate(statrec=cumWins/sum(cumWins,cumLosses),
         dif500=statrec-0.5,
         absdif500=abs(statrec-0.5))%>%
  ungroup()

#' Create grouping columns for plots.
#totmid$y_above <- ifelse(totmid$statrec >= 0.5, totmid$statrec, 0.5)
#totmid$y_below <- ifelse(totmid$statrec <= 0.5, totmid$statrec, 0.5)

#' Merge game data with team data.
totmid2=merge(totmid,df_dict_nba_teams,by="idTeam")

#' Filter for current teams only.
curr=totmid2%>%filter(yearPlayedLast==2025)

#' Count of all 0.500 occurrences for each team.
csm=curr%>%filter(statrec==0.5)%>%
  count(nameTeam.y)

#' Count of all games for each team.
tm=curr%>%
  count(nameTeam.y)

#' Merge count data.
csm2=merge(csm,tm,by="nameTeam.y")

#' Calculate normalized 0.500 occurrences value.
csm2=csm2%>%mutate(norm=n.x/n.y)

#' Bar chart of 0.500 occurrences.
p1=ggplot(csm2,aes(x=n.x,y=reorder(nameTeam.y,n.x)))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity",color="black",aes(fill=norm*100))+
  geom_text(aes(label=as.character(n.x),x=n.x+15))+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey80", high = "blue4",name="% Games 0.500")+
  xlab("# Intra-season 0.500")+
  ylab("Team")+
  theme_bw()

#' For each team, number of 0.500 occurrences by season.
csmy=curr%>%filter(statrec==0.5)%>%
  count(nameTeam.y,yearSeason)%>%
  group_by(nameTeam.y)%>%
  mutate(sum=sum(n))

p2=ggplot(csmy,aes(x=yearSeason,y=reorder(nameTeam.y,sum),fill=n))+
  geom_tile(color="black")+
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey80", high = "red4",name="# Intra-season 0.500")+
  xlab("Season")+
  ylab("Team")+
  theme_bw()

p1+p2 + plot_layout(axes="collect", guides="collect",widths=c(3,4))

#' League-wide 0.500 occurrences for each season.
test=csmy%>%group_by(yearSeason)%>%summarize(total=sum(n))
```
